analyst.summary: L&T Finance, the L&T-promoted retail NBFC, delivered another strong quarter (Q1 FY27, Jun-2026): consolidated profit up ~29-31% YoY, loan book up 27% YoY, and continued improvement in asset quality including in the microfinance book where industry-wide stress has been a concern. Capital and liquidity buffers are comfortable and the balance sheet shows no red flags. The main caveat is that the stock already trades at a rich valuation (roughly 23x earnings, ~2.6-2.8x book) that assumes management's 2031 targets (higher return on equity, lower credit costs) get delivered over the next few years - a reasonable but not yet proven bet. We rate it a Hold: good business, well-priced-to-perfection stock.
